expectedThingsPrinted: You are standing outside the office building.
The door is slightly ajar, revealing a dimly lit interior.
What do you want to do?
1. Enter the office
2. Go home
You push open the door and step inside.
As you cross the threshold, you feel a cold wind blow through the building.
Your vision blurs temporarily!  And then you regain your footing.
{"jLineColor":3,"text":"Demons tried to possess you!"}
1. Go back outside
2. Take a closer look at the receptionist's desk
3. Check out Bill's office
4. Check out the Lobby restroom
5. Check out the cubicle farm
Papers strewn everywhere!  Half of the cubicle walls knocked over.
Signs of demonic invasion everywhere ... it's a complete mess!
Someone's spinal chord ripped out and hung from the ceiling!
{"jLineColor":3,"text":"You hear moans!"}
{"jLineColor":3,"text":"You see hoards of zombies!"}
{"jLineColor":1,"text":"They see you!"}
1. Go back to the lobby
2. Make a mad dash for the elevator
You high-tail it out of the cubicle farm.
But you are not safe!
{"jLineColor":1,"text":"The zombies are fast sprinters!"}
{"jLineColor":1,"text":"They followed you right out here and ate you!!!"}
